title: Building & Scaling AI-Driven Ventures in Regulated Sectors
subtitle: Attolloo Group is an asset-light venture studio and competence investor. We contribute senior executive depth (CEO, CSO, HR) and validated frameworks in exchange for equity or performance-based revenue shares — not dilutive capital.

sections.body: Early-stage AI companies in regulated sectors rarely fail due to technology — they fail due to governance, regulatory navigation, and execution gaps. Attolloo supplies C-level leadership (CEO, CSO, HR) and board-level rigor when it matters most.
sections.heading: Capital is Abundant. Executive Depth is Not.
Proprietary 4-Pillar Stack
sections.body:
* 6Sense Filter™ — Qualification & investor screening (unit economics, EMV risk).

* AI Compass™ — 1–5★ digital & organizational maturity diagnostic[cite.

* Polaris Sprints™ — 90-day execution sprints governed by hybrid agile & RACI.

* KANDO Framework™ — Theory of Constraints (TOC) execution & operational excellence.

sections.heading: Attolloo Lab — Method in Action
sections.body: We deploy our methodology directly into active venture pilots to unlock working capital and ensure regulatory moats. Current focus candidate: DeepXL.ai (Forensic AI & identity verification for financial institutions and government)

sections.heading: Led by Nils Johan Brede
sections.body:
